title: Create a site settings global
description: Keep shared site-wide values in a single global instead of scattering them across collections.
problem: You need one shared place for site name, support details, and other site-wide settings.
summary: Use a global for singleton content that should be edited once and reused across the site or app.
runtimeNotes: Singleton content modeling pattern is runtime-independent.
intents: manage site-wide content in one place
